title: Representably flat functors preserve compatible families
statement: Let $C,D$ be categories, $K$ a Grothendieck topology on $D$, and $G:C\to D$ a representably flat functor (for every $d\in D$ the comma category $(d\downarrow G)$ is cofiltered). Then $G$ is compatible-preserving for $K$ in the following precise sense. For every set-valued $K$-sheaf $P$, every presieve $T$ on $z\in C$, every compatible family $x$ of $G^{\mathrm{op}}P$ on $T$, every pair $g_i:y_i\to z$ in $T$, and every $f_i:w\to G(y_i)$ with $G(g_1)f_1=G(g_2)f_2$, one has $P(f_1)(x_{g_1})=P(f_2)(x_{g_2})$. This holds for sheaves of sets in any universe; equivalently, $\operatorname{CompatiblePreserving}(K,G)$ holds. Here presheaves of sets are contravariant functors to sets, in the convention of [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology](1).
